description: Implements ASCII85 encoding and decoding filter for PDF processing within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: Ascii85Decode
classes.description: A class that provides methods to encode and decode data using the ASCII85 filter for PDF processing.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes input byte array into ASCII85 format with special handling for zero blocks and padding.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes ASCII85 formatted data back into raw byte array, handling whitespace, padding, and special characters.
